title: 第12章 第一形态第13章 切磋
content_zh:
“99%。”
陈冲胸腹起伏，息吐成风，正在全力运转呼吸法。
桌上已经空了两条营养膏，还剩十余条。
他怕最后会拼夕夕式的卡进度，所以准备充裕，今晚打定主意要看一看这神秘的数字到达100%会带来什么。
又一遍呼吸法练完，陈冲觉得浑身发热，力量勃发，腹中稍显饥饿。
气道和血脉都有拉扯与胀大的感觉，呼吸法的负担的确很重；但随着腹内营养膏的消化，不适感又在迅速消退。
“饿了都觉得难吃，是真的难吃。”
陈冲又撕开一条营养膏，暗自想着。
听姑爹说过，好多年前营养膏刚流行时，口味百花齐放，甚至能直接模拟出饭店名肴的滋味，要多好吃有多好吃。
那时各品牌的营养膏价格也低，营养又高，味道还好，很快都要取代正餐了。
然而听说中心城不久便出了个什么政策，滋味可口的营养膏很快下市，后面的营养膏变成了要多难吃有多难吃。
于是但凡有条件的家庭，还是将食品工厂出产的米粮当作正餐，花在食物上的钱越来越多。
这正是中心城那些巨企的目的。
“这个世界差一点就消除饥饿了，可惜巨企只关心利益，不关心多少人会饿死。”
这是一个对普通人不友善的世界。
上升通道近乎断绝，坠落到荒原的空间倒是巨大，譬如他现在。
陈冲吸了口气，又打开一条营养膏，滋溜一下吸进口中，慢慢咀嚼这跟橡皮泥差不多的东西，然后一点一点的咽下。
想太远也没用，打破眼下的困局才是要紧。
陈冲眉眼低垂，交替练习着呼吸法和搏击操，以助食物的消化。
99%……100%。

终于，眼前的数字跳变了一下，第一次达到了三位数。
正在对着窗外月光挥拳的陈冲忽然僵住了，就像被神秘的存在按下了暂停键。
从正面看过去，他的双眼迅速变得一片赤红，其中隐约有六芒星闪烁。
而陈冲自己的意识则沉浸入广阔的星海，面前再次出现那口六角古井。
星空不断闪烁，一个庞大的意志正在冉冉升起，让陈冲感到战栗。
“第一形态，【吞噬】，开启。”
庞然意念直接在陈冲脑海中响起。
轰的一声，星海震荡，古井里飞出一道虚影，不断升腾，不断扭转，直至横压整片星空。
这道虚影似龙似象，似狮似虎，似麒麟而非麒麟，不同于陈冲认识的任何一种异兽形象。
它头顶双角修长，如同羚羊昂首，腹中花纹玄奥，就像阔口人面。
它唇生利齿，如同宝剑，背长双翼，如欲腾飞。四蹄翻飞，长尾如龙，双目血红，唇含诡笑。
异兽形象极怪，优雅中有三分邪异，邪异里带着十分霸气，看上去不是神兽就是凶兽——还是像凶兽更多一点。
凶兽虚影在星海中遨游一圈，头颅回转，缓缓低垂，猩红双目中倒映出陈冲的影子。
下一刻，虚影咻的一声落下，飞入陈冲的额头。
陈冲猛的睁开眼睛。
双目中红光一闪，他剧烈的喘息了几声，像是窒息已久刚刚才获得了氧气。
“第一形态，吞噬……”
陈冲喃喃道。
刚刚的那个瞬间，他脑海中莫名多了一些信息。
content_en:
"99%."
Chen Chong's chest and abdomen were rising and falling, his breath was blowing out, and he was using his breathing technique at full strength.
Two strips of nutritional cream are already empty on the table, with more than ten strips left.
He was afraid that he would end up struggling to achieve a Xixi-like progress, so he was fully prepared. He made up his mind tonight to see what this mysterious number would bring if it reached 100%.
After practicing the breathing method again, Chen Chong felt hot all over his body, full of strength, and a little hungry in his stomach.
The airways and blood vessels both felt stretched and swollen, and the burden of the breathing method was indeed heavy; but as the nutritional cream in the abdomen was digested, the discomfort quickly subsided.
"It tastes bad even when I'm hungry. It's really bad."
Chen Chong tore open another strip of nutritional ointment and thought to himself.
I heard my aunt say that many years ago when nutritional creams first became popular, there were all kinds of flavors, and they could even directly simulate the taste of famous restaurant dishes. They were as delicious as you wanted.
At that time, various brands of nutritional creams were also cheap, highly nutritious, and tasted good. They would soon replace meals.
However, I heard that Central City soon came up with some policy, and the delicious nutritional cream was quickly sold out, and the subsequent nutritional creams became as unpalatable as possible.
Therefore, families who have the conditions still use rice produced by food factories as dinner, and spend more and more money on food.
This is exactly the purpose of those giant companies in Central City.
"The world is close to eradicating hunger, but it's a pity that giant companies only care about profits and don't care how many people will starve to death."
This is a world that is unkind to ordinary people.
The ascending passage is almost cut off, and the space for falling into the wasteland is huge, such as he is now.
Chen Chong took a breath, opened another tube of nutritional ointment, sucked it into his mouth, slowly chewed the thing that was similar to plasticine, and then swallowed it bit by bit.
There is no point in thinking too far ahead. Breaking the current predicament is what matters.
Chen Chong lowered his eyebrows and practiced breathing techniques and boxing exercises alternately to help digest food.
99%…100%.
Finally, the number in front of me jumped and reached three digits for the first time.
Chen Chong, who was shaking his fist at the moonlight outside the window, suddenly froze, as if a mysterious being had pressed the pause button.
Looking from the front, his eyes quickly turned red, with six-pointed stars twinkling faintly in them.
Chen Chong's own consciousness was immersed in the vast sea of ​​​​stars, and the hexagonal ancient well appeared in front of him again.
The starry sky kept twinkling, and a huge will was rising, which made Chen Chong feel trembling.
"The first form, [Swallow], is activated."
Pang Ran's thoughts directly sounded in Chen Chong's mind.
With a bang, the sea of ​​stars shook, and a shadow flew out of the ancient well, rising and twisting until it stretched across the entire starry sky.
This phantom resembled a dragon, an elephant, a lion, a tiger, a unicorn but not a unicorn. It was different from any other strange beast Chen Chong knew.
The two horns on its head are long and slender, like an antelope's head, and the pattern on its belly is mysterious, like a wide-mouthed human face.
It has sharp teeth on its lips, like a sword, and wings on its back, as if it wants to take flight. The four hooves are flying, the tail is as long as a dragon, the eyes are blood red, and there is a sly smile on the lips.
The image of the alien beast is extremely strange, with a certain amount of elegance and domineering character. It looks like either a mythical beast or a ferocious beast - more like a ferocious beast.
The phantom of the ferocious beast swam in a circle in the sea of ​​​​stars, its head turned and slowly lowered, and Chen Chong's shadow was reflected in the scarlet eyes.
The next moment, the shadow fell down with a hiss and flew into Chen Chong's forehead.
Chen Chong opened his eyes fiercely.
A red light flashed in his eyes, and he gasped violently, as if he had just received oxygen after being suffocated for a long time.
"First form, swallow..."
Chen Chong murmured.
At that moment, there was inexplicably more information in his mind.
